overview: The Medford City Council granted secondhand and taxi licenses, settled a municipal claim, and requested records and equipment inventory for community access television. The council also discussed repurposing a downtown transit shelter and requested valuation and tax rate scenario data ahead of the annual classification hearing.

items.title: Commendation of Michael Ryan
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Michael Ryan on his retirement as executive director of the Friends of the Middlesex Fells Reservation.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Irene Platty
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of former school cafeteria worker Irene Platty.

items.title: Secondhand Article License for Cache Point
items.summary: Approved a secondhand article license for Nyan Group, Inc., doing business as Cache Point, at 32 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Taxi Operator License for Albert T. Morenci
items.summary: Approved a taxi operator license for Albert T. Morenci driving for Citywide Taxi.

items.title: Petition on Nonprofit Finances and TV3 Inventory
items.summary: Passed an amended motion requesting that the city solicitor provide financial records and an itemized equipment inventory related to Medford Community Access Television.

items.title: Claim Settlement for Patricia DeJesus
items.summary: Approved a property damage settlement of $3,246.59 for a vehicle struck by Medford Fire Department Engine 7.

items.title: Repurposing of Riverside Avenue Shelter
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the city examine repurposing the shelter at River Street and Riverside Avenue for arts or other community uses, with added lighting.

items.title: Congratulating Medford High Football Team
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating the Medford High School football team on its Thanksgiving Day victory over Malden High.

items.title: Clarification on MassDOT Waterway Taxi Hearing
items.summary: Requested an explanatory update from the city engineer and Office of Community Development regarding a MassDOT public hearing on waterway taxi project easements.

items.title: Traffic Commission Updates and Bus Stop Meeting
items.summary: Requested updates from the Traffic Commission on traffic-calming proposals and asked to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting on relocating a Main Street bus stop.

items.title: Information Request for Tax Rate Classification Hearing
items.summary: Requested that the Chief Assessor provide financial models, residential exemption options, new tax revenue numbers, and property revaluation status reports prior to the tax rate hearing.
